test_suite: Bounded Dual-Stream Retrieval & Integrity Verification (TC-01 through TC-10)

test_cases.name: Simple Greeting Bypass
test_cases.expected_result: Immediate static greeting response; zero embedding calls, zero SQL queries, zero LLM generation calls.
test_cases.actual_result: Static response returned: 'Hello! I am Dr. Sara Hegy's executive coaching assistant. How can I support your leadership development today?'; 0 embeddings, 0 SQL, 0 LLM.

test_cases.name: Zero-Result Retrieval Gating & Fallback
test_cases.input_query: How do I practice Completion with Integrity when closing projects?
test_cases.expected_result: Candidate chunks below thresholds (0.70 framework / 0.65 voice); Hard Gate routes to Return Zero Result Output; LLM strictly bypassed; exact fallback string returned.
test_cases.actual_result: Exact fallback returned: 'No documented coaching frameworks match this topic.'; Hard Gate branch zero_results=1; Ollama Grounded Generator bypassed.

test_cases.name: Relevant Communication / Style Query (Positive Voice Retrieval)
test_cases.input_query: Look, Mark, is micromanagement really an ego problem or an information architecture breakdown?
test_cases.expected_result: Voice sample retrieved above 0.65 threshold; framework below 0.70; LLM generated response reflecting Dr. Sara's signature voice without hallucinating framework definitions.
test_cases.actual_result: Voice chunk retrieved (similarity: 0.6720); Framework stream returned 0 rows; LLM generated grounded coaching guidance; Hard Gate branch has_results=1.

test_cases.name: Dual-Stream Qualifying Query (Framework + Voice)
test_cases.input_query: How do top performers use the Completion with Integrity framework and binary exit criteria to eliminate micromanagement?
test_cases.expected_result: Both streams qualify (framework >= 0.70 and voice >= 0.65); total qualifying chunks >= 2; LLM response grounded in framework facts and calibrated with authentic voice.
test_cases.actual_result: 1 framework chunk (similarity: 0.7666) and 2 voice chunks (similarity: 0.6850) retrieved; LLM generated grounded response free of prompt leakage and case-study confusion.

test_cases.name: Similarity Threshold Enforcement (>= 0.70 Framework / >= 0.65 Voice)
test_cases.input_query: Verification of deterministic SQL WHERE clauses in Retrieve Framework Stream and Retrieve Voice Stream nodes.
test_cases.expected_result: Hard cosine similarity thresholds enforced in PostgreSQL SQL query before returning rows to n8n.
test_cases.actual_result: Verified in workflow definitions and runtime SQL traces: Framework uses 'WHERE stream_type = \'framework\' AND (1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector)) >= 0.70'; Voice uses 'WHERE stream_type = \'voice_sample\' AND (1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector)) >= 0.65'.

test_cases.name: Retrieval Limit Enforcement (LIMIT 2 Per Stream)
test_cases.input_query: How does an executive protect cognitive bandwidth and let the architecture absorb ambiguity?
test_cases.expected_result: SQL queries strictly enforce LIMIT 2 per stream, returning at most 2 framework chunks and 2 voice chunks regardless of total matching candidate vectors.
test_cases.actual_result: SQL clauses include 'LIMIT 2'; exactly 2 voice chunks returned despite multiple candidates in knowledge_vault; framework returned 0 rows.

test_cases.name: Unrelated Query Negative Gating (Zero Results Branch)
test_cases.input_query: What is the optimal fertilizer ratio for growing hydroponic tomatoes in winter?
test_cases.expected_result: Zero chunks qualify; Hard Gate routes to Return Zero Result Output; Ollama Grounded Generator never executed; exact fallback string returned.
test_cases.actual_result: Framework count: 0, Voice count: 0; Hard Gate routes to False branch; Output: 'No documented coaching frameworks match this topic.'; 0 LLM calls.

test_cases.name: Invalid or Malformed Query Vector Handling
test_cases.expected_result: Validate Query Vector node catches invalid embedding, asserts 1024 finite floats, and halts execution before issuing SQL queries.
test_cases.actual_result: Validate Query Vector node unit test proved: throws descriptive error on null, empty, non-1024 length, or non-finite float; PostgreSQL queries strictly prevented.

test_cases.name: Rejected Meeting Relational Isolation
test_cases.input_query: Verification that non-coaching sessions (SES-103, SES-104) never enter knowledge_vault or receive embeddings.
test_cases.expected_result: Rejected meetings stored in rejected_meetings table only; 0 embeddings in rejected_meetings; 0 chunks from SES-103/104 in knowledge_vault.
test_cases.actual_result: Direct DB query confirmed: rejected_meetings table contains SES-103 (Internal Ops) and SES-104 (Sales Discovery) with 0 vector columns; knowledge_vault contains exclusively Client Coaching sessions.

test_cases.name: Workflow & Database Integrity Regression
test_cases.input_query: Post-ingestion regression check of active states, table row counts, and duplicate avoidance.
test_cases.expected_result: Both workflows remain inactive (active: false); knowledge_vault has exactly 16 rows; rejected_meetings has exactly 4 rows; 0 duplicate sessions.
test_cases.actual_result: Ingestion active: false, Retrieval active: false; knowledge_vault: 16 rows (8 test + 8 prod); rejected_meetings: 4 rows (2 test + 2 prod); 0 duplicates.
